provenance.variant: UTC as defined since 1961-01-01: 1961-1971 offsets with rate terms, integer leap seconds from 1972
provenance.conditions: TAI - UTC = offset_s + (MJD_UTC - mjd_reference) * rate_s_per_day from jd_utc_start; the 1972+ steps are cross-checked against NAIF DELTET/DELTA_AT at build time.
provenance.uncertainty: Exact by definition (IERS Bulletin C / BIH); valid until the next announced leap second.
